after.title: Finite naimark isometric compression
after.statement_or_definition: For a finite complete effect family E_a on H, the map Vx=sum_a sqrt(E_a)x tensor |a> into H tensor C^m is an isometry, and E_a=V†(I tensor |a><a|)V. proof_obligations: V†V=sum E_a=I by orthogonal labels and sqrt(E_a)²=E_a. Compress each label projector directly to E_a; cycle finite traces to identify probabilities.

after.title: Amplitude table precision and compilation
after.statement_or_definition: Given a target unit vector a in C^D, rational component approximations v with each real/imaginary error≤2^(−b), let eta=sqrt(2D)2^(−b)<1/2. Then v is nonzero and ||v/||v||−a||≤2eta. Prefix preparation for the normalized v table, compiled as one full unconditional block with sum of local projective unitary errors≤epsilon_c, yields output ray within 2eta+epsilon_c in chord distance of [a]. Finite-alphabet gate count uses the preceding control-ladder length G=O((n+1)D) and at most O(G log^c(G/epsilon_c)) fixed-arity compiled gates, c=log_(3/2)5; table reading costs Omega(Db). A uniform bit-time bound is held until certified angle evaluation and thm-qc-solovay-kitaev-bit-complexity are authored.
proof_obligations: Euclidean component bound gives ||v−a||≤eta; reverse triangle gives | ||v||−1 |≤eta, and splitting v/||v||−a through v gives ≤2eta.

Treat the entire preparation as a product of explicitly expanded bounded-arity unitary blocks. Whole-block projective errors telescope after multiplying the chosen scalars; restrict to |0> input, then take projective chord distance and triangle inequality. Preparation is unconditional; never control individually phase-minimized blocks.

Choose b so eta meets its assigned error budget. Preserve preprocessing and input cost separately; finite certified computation of angles and SK branch stability remains an exact named authoring prerequisite, not hidden in this gate-count result.
